unit: claim case; report clusters by notice/original/template and semantic group
accept_event: policy disposition accept_shadow after shared hard checks; action readiness separately evaluated
detection_event: explicit error/conflict flag identifying the affected claim with reason/evidence, not generic review or provider failure
operational_policy: Failures remain in scheduled yield, separately counted; no detector credit for operational fallback.

denominators.A_valid: Accepted claims independently valid to original source and supported by visible parse, with role/precision/conditions intact.
denominators.A_invalid: Accepted claims invalid to original source or unsupported by their declared parser evidence.
denominators.A_unresolved: Accepted claims whose truth/support remains unresolved, including settled acceptance of a source conflict.
denominators.V: All scheduled valid, source-resolvable proposal cases.
denominators.E: Scheduled cases with unambiguously invalid proposals or unsupported parser-text claims under frozen labels. Source-conflicted/unresolved truth has separate U denominator; do not silently pool. Source-fidelity and text-support versions of E are named separately.
denominators.F_error: Explicit error flags among E on successful verifier responses.
denominators.F_valid: Explicit error flags among V on successful verifier responses.
denominators.F_unresolved: Explicit error flags among U; show separately, not in resolved precision.
denominators.R_valid: Valid cases escalated/reviewed by policy, separated into semantic, hard-check and operational reasons.

metrics.acceptance_precision_resolved: A_valid / (A_valid + A_invalid); undefined if denominator zero; display A_unresolved alongside.
metrics.unsafe_acceptance_fraction: (A_invalid + A_unresolved) / (A_valid + A_invalid + A_unresolved); undefined if no acceptances.
metrics.false_acceptance_fraction_resolved: A_invalid / (A_valid + A_invalid); not the same denominator as escaped-error rate.
metrics.escaped_error_fraction: A_invalid / E, using invalid-case membership; when unsupported visible evidence is an additional invalid dimension, use the frozen union E without double counting.
metrics.error_detection_recall: F_error / E; scheduled denominator; operational failures do not count as detections.
metrics.error_detection_precision_resolved: F_error / (F_error + F_valid); undefined if no resolved flags; report F_unresolved.
metrics.correct_acceptance_coverage: A_valid / V; scheduled denominator, missing/failed responses reduce coverage.
metrics.unnecessary_escalation: R_valid / V; report reason breakdown, not automatically verifier error.
metrics.unresolved_acceptance: A_unresolved / U, with total U and source-conflict subset.
metrics.conflict_routing: Source-conflict cases explicitly routed to review with conflict evidence / all source-conflict cases; show generic/operational review separately.
metrics.normalization_support_accuracy: Per-dimension and all-four joint agreement on predeclared unique or set-valued labels; primary gate accuracy on resolved expected conjunction. Successful-response and scheduled-yield denominators separately.
metrics.candidate_coverage: Source-labeled required field instances with at least one sufficient faithful candidate / all source-labeled required field instances; exclude genuine not_stated, report explicit_negative separately.
metrics.end_to_end_required_field_yield: Correctly accepted source-grounded required field instances / all determinate required field instances, including missing candidates and operational failures.
metrics.document_action_readiness: Notices with all required critical roles correctly covered, destinations verified, no accepted source conflicts and no unsupported critical extras / all scheduled notices; source-unresolved notices remain separately counted.
metrics.cost_per_correct_accept: Known incremental verifier charge / A_valid; undefined if zero; retain unknown charges, currency/credit separation and parser replay accounting separately.
metrics.source_fidelity_escape: Text-accepted claims incorrect/unresolved against original source / all text-accepted claims, including same-parser corrupted-value blind spots; no credit for unsupported guesses that happen to repair them.

calibration: Diagnostic only; no primary threshold. General categorical output has no probability score. Jev probability bins/Brier descriptive on resolved labels only; 16 selected cases cannot establish calibration.
zero_denominator: null plus reason; never replace with 0 or 1
primary_gate: No deterministic blocking issues AND completed/schema-valid response AND support=supported AND role=matched AND condition=preserved AND conflict=absent. Otherwise escalation; probability/confidence never controls primary gate.
primary_gate_eligibility: Independent pre-run label review establishes unique expected text-gate outcome. Ambiguous gate cases remain scheduled and get bounds/sensitivity, excluded from resolved-gate accuracy. Dimension ambiguity alone need not exclude a uniquely failing gate.
